name: github-image-upload
title_zh: 本地图片直传 GitHub 讨论串，回帖即显图
tagline_zh: 不用再开新窗口传图床、贴外链。PR 描述、Issue、评论里直接嵌本地截图/PDF/zip。
tagline_en: Stop juggling image hosts. Embed local screenshots, PDFs, zips straight into PRs, issues, comments—private repos.
desc_en: Upload local images and other files (PDF, zip, log, …) to GitHub and embed them in a pull request description, an issue, or a comment — producing canonical github.com/user-attachments URLs (private-repo uploads stay private). Use when asked to "attach a screenshot to the PR", "add an image to the PR description", "put this image in the issue", "attach this PDF/log/zip to the issue", "show test res
why_zh: 它生成的是 github.com/user-attachments 官方链接，不依赖第三方图床。
why_en: Produces canonical github.com/user-attachments URLs—no third-party host, permanent links that respect repo permissions.
limit_zh: 只负责上传并生成 Markdown 链接，不帮你裁剪、压缩或转换图片格式。
limit_en: Uploads & returns Markdown only—no editing, compressing, or format conversion. Requires GitHub CLI authenticated with write access to the target repo.
title_en: Local images straight into GitHub threads, visible in.
